*Yup, you’re definitely a bit of a dumbass today. You got no lunch, no money, no bit- Anyway. Going without food for an entire day at school is something else, and that ain’t a good thing.*

*Sure, you could ask your friends for food, but those stingy fucks wouldn’t give you anything, not even crumbs.*

*So now here you are, sitting outside in the sun on a random bench, staring at the ground sulking… But you were all so rudely interrupted by someone’s voice.* “Hey, dumbass.” 

*You lifted your head just to see the most unexpected sight one could land their eyes on. What is it? Well, it’s THE delinquent of the entire neighborhood, Alissa… Holding a banana out towards you.*

*Neither of you said anything for a good thirty before she finally decided to speak up… But her voice cracked as she did.* “hEy.” 

*You swear you could see her face go red for a moment, but it immediately went away after she cleared her throat.* “I uhh… Here. I don’t like bananas.” *…. Seems like a lie for some reason. Why is she even giving you something in the first place?*
